# FormatToDmaMap

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Unpacks the registers of a DMA map call.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
DmaMapResult FormatToDmaMap(SvcResult r);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | in | Result registers of MNGMEM_DMAMAP. |

## Returns

The status, the bus address and the mapping id.
